opp-most-opp.label: KKR's most-played opponent
opp-most-opp.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
opp-most-opp.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (6) OR m.team2_id IN (6)) AND (m.team1_id IN (13) OR m.team2_id IN (13)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL
